event_summary: A brown round object and a red rectangular object remain suspended near the top, then move downward and come to rest on two white cushions.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with two white cushions at the bottom and two colored holders near the top: a blue holder at upper left with a brown round object nearby and an orange-black holder at upper right with a red rectangular object nearby. The arrangement stays still for many frames. Later, the brown round object and red rectangular object separate from the upper holders and move downward with visible blur. The brown object reaches the left cushion and remains there, while the red object reaches the right cushion, changes orientation, and remains there.

reasons: The two upper objects, two holders, and two lower cushions are visible before any visible motion.
The camera view includes the relevant upper and lower regions of the scene.
